item.title: DCH to Offer PALS Recertification Class January 23
item.description: Daviess Community Hospital will offer a PALS recertification class for healthcare professionals on Friday, January 23. The Pediatric Advanced Life Support course will be held from 9 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. at Daviess Community Hospital in Washington.
